verdict.rationale: Manufact creates per-branch preview environments, each with its own MCP URL separate from the production branch's canonical URL, so changes can be tested with real clients before merging. It also supports running servers locally with an inspector. However, nothing in the evidence shows that previews are isolated from production data, such as separate environment variables, secrets or backing data stores. Previews therefore isolate deployments, not demonstrably data. Missing for 10: documented data or secret isolation between preview and production environments, per-environment variable scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
